steps.name: assert-pano-tour-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.panoTour !== false) throw new Error('panoTour flag should be OFF in Simple mode but got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.panoTour)

steps.name: assert-pano-tour-enabled-in-pro
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.panoTour) throw new Error('panoTour flag should be ON in Pro mode')

steps.name: add-two-stops-via-store
steps.eval: window.__store.setState({ panoTourStops: [{ id: 'demo-stop-1', label: 'Living Room', position: [9, 3] }, { id: 'demo-stop-2', label: 'Kitchen', position: [4, 3] }], panoTourActiveId: 'demo-stop-1' })

steps.name: assert-two-stops
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().panoTourStops.length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected 2 tour stops, got ' + window.__store.getState().panoTourStops.length)

steps.name: assert-stop-tabs-render
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay button')).filter(b => b.textContent?.includes('Living Room') || b.textContent?.includes('Kitchen')); if (btns.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 stop tab buttons (Living Room + Kitchen), found: ' + btns.length); })()

steps.name: assert-plan-has-stop-markers
steps.eval: (() => { const circles = document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen circle'); if (circles.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 circles (stop markers) in plan editor, found: ' + circles.length); })()

steps.name: assert-pano-tour-hidden-again
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.panoTour !== false) throw new Error('panoTour should be OFF again in Simple mode')
